comments.text: The Maldives looks like paradise, but I keep wondering what everyday life is really like when you live so far out in the Indian Ocean. Beautiful views are one thing — but what about schools, groceries, hospitals, storms, and daily work? I’d love to hear from someone who actually lives there.
